messages.subject: Limits on the size of data frames
messages.subject_clean: Limits on the size of data frames
messages.body_plain:
Hello all,

I had a question about whether there are limits on the size of data frames
that WhatIf can analyze. The observed covariate data I have is a 440,768 x
7 numeric data frame and the counterfactual data is a 50,238 x 7 numeric
data frame. Is it feasible to use WhatIf with data frames this large? How
long should I expect it to take? I have let R run for a few hours but it
remains stuck "Performing convex hull test...".

Thank you,
Erica
